name: Top-and-Bottom (TAB)
summary: Left and right eye views stacked vertically in a single frame. Less common than SBS but supported by many of the same displays. Preserves horizontal resolution at the cost of vertical.

variants.name: Full TAB
variants.description: Each eye gets the full vertical resolution. Frame is twice the normal height.

variants.name: Half TAB
variants.description: Each eye view is vertically compressed to half height, fitting both into a standard frame. Most common for broadcast and display compatibility.
